overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the official posted notice gave the correct 6 P.M. start, and the wrong online calendar time did not change that. No remedy ordered; the IT Department had already corrected the calendar.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly convened its February 2 meeting one hour before the start time shown on the City's online event calendar.
allegations.key_passage: the Board did not violate the law by holding its meeting at 6 P.M.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly proceeded with the February 2 meeting after acknowledging at its start a discrepancy between the calendar and the notice.
allegations.key_passage: The minutes do not reflect any such discussion about the discrepancy.
